Name: Label
Description: A display label for the SubUniverseClass.

Name: Description
Description: A description of the content and purpose of the SubUniverseClass.

Name: DefiningConceptReference
Description: A concept that provides a grouping factor for the Universes contained by the SubUniverseClass. For example, if the parent Universe is "Manufacturing businesses" and the member Universes are "Businesses with fewer than 50 employees" and "Businesses with at least 50 employees", the defining concept is "Number of employees".

Name: UniverseReference
Description: A reference to a Universe contained in this SubUniverseClass. Different parent Universes may reuse the same SubUniverseClass and its member Universes. For example, the Universes "Manufacturing businesses" and "Retail businesses" may both reference a SubUniverseClass defined by number of employees, with member Universes "Businesses with fewer than 50 employees" and "Businesses with at least 50 employees". The SubUniverseClass always restricts its parent Universe, so the latter member means "Manufacturing businesses with at least 50 employees" in one case and "Retail businesses with at least 50 employees" in the other. A question or variable should reference each relevant Universe to identify the intended intersection. Geographic areas and reference periods are specified in Population descriptions.

Name: SubUniverseClassReference
Description: A reference to a SubUniverseClass contained in this SubUniverseClass (a means of nesting hierarchies).

Name: IsOrdered
Description: If set to "true" indicates that the content of the group is ordered.
